text:
The builder is likely to recover $14,000, calculated as the contract price ($20,000) minus the cost to complete ($5,000) minus the resale of unused materials ($1,000). This is the standard expectation measure for a wrongfully terminated construction contract. The $3,000 increase in property value is not the correct measure here because the builder’s lost profit and reliance are recoverable under contract law.

CONFIDENCE: 90
